destination.suggested_title: Transactional Temporal Indicator History Ownership & Commit Composition

why_F_KT_owns_next_step: F-SI25 intentionally does not persist previous accepted right-derivative history.
The previous derivative is continuation state: it becomes authoritative only when the physical candidate is actually accepted/committed.
Rejected, retried or rolled-back trials must not advance that history.
Checkpoint/retry/rollback/commit ownership already belongs to F-KT.
F-KT09 already owns generic model-owned temporal-certificate transport and rollback/retry semantics, while explicitly not owning the Richards estimator itself.

required_F_KT10_semantics.history_payload: previous accepted Richards right derivative required by F-SI25 on the next accepted-step evaluation
required_F_KT10_semantics.initial_state: history unavailable is explicit; F-SI25 returns current derivative but no B_inf certificate on warmup
required_F_KT10_semantics.trial_read: a trial may read only history belonging to its exact committed origin state/lineage
required_F_KT10_semantics.trial_write: candidate current_right_derivative remains attempt-local until commit
required_F_KT10_semantics.retry: failed/rejected/retried attempt discards its derivative candidate and rereads unchanged committed history
required_F_KT10_semantics.rollback: restores exact pre-attempt history availability/value and provenance
required_F_KT10_semantics.commit: on actual accepted physical commit, current_right_derivative becomes the next committed previous derivative atomically with the accepted state transition
required_F_KT10_semantics.generic_time: history is associated with accepted interval provenance, not calendar day boundaries
required_F_KT10_semantics.feature_scope: allocate/store derivative history only for columns/execution classes where the qualified indicator path is active
required_F_KT10_semantics.restart_checkpoint: if continuation/restart is in scope, the derivative history and availability/provenance must be included in checkpoint sufficiency; otherwise fail closed rather than silently warm-starting with unrelated history
required_F_KT10_semantics.MultiSWAP: no one-heavy-object-per-column requirement; storage must remain compatible with feature-scoped arrays/pools/SoA

F_MR18_relationship.may_be_used_as: generic proof that an actual F-KT commit occurred and for exact lineage/revision/t0/t1 handoff where composition needs it
F_MR18_relationship.must_not_be_used_as: owner or persistent carrier of Richards derivative history
F_MR18_relationship.reason: F-MR18's qualified receipt contract deliberately contains provenance only, no domain payload and no persistent column state.

required_tests: warmup: unavailable history yields no temporal indicator but exposes a finite current derivative candidate
accepted commit: exactly the accepted candidate derivative becomes committed history
rejected temporal trial: committed history bitwise unchanged
solver rejection: committed history bitwise unchanged
hard-mass rejection: committed history bitwise unchanged
retry with shorter dt: every retry starts from the same committed derivative history until one candidate commits
rollback after trial: derivative history and availability/provenance exactly restored
A-B-A column ordering: no cross-column history leakage
inactive feature columns: no derivative-history allocation/cost

generic interval/substep composition: history advances at each privately accepted substep only if that substep is the authoritative F-KT accepted continuation point; external publication semantics remain unchanged
hard mass and physical state unchanged by history plumbing
F-SI25 frozen 16-case production replay remains numerically identical when history is supplied transactionally
hard_holds: Do not select a scientific temporal tolerance in F-KT10.
Do not normalize B_inf into the F-KT09 dimensionless <=1 certificate contract without separate scientific evidence and qualification.
Do not reinterpret B_inf as a general nonlinear true-error bound.
Do not introduce q_cap, Nmin, geometric tail multipliers, fitted safety factors or deep refinement trajectories.
Do not change Richards physics, boundary semantics or mass accounting.
Do not make history persistent for columns that never use the indicator.
Do not expose HeadCalc internals to F-KT/runtime.
Do not move physical commit authority out of F-KT.
Do not release F-GC02, groundwater coupling or F-PE from this composition alone.

downstream_after_F_KT10.qualification_scope: transaction-composed production indicator/history semantics, noninterference, bounded cost and frozen F-VQ30 replay; any scientific normalization/tolerance must be separately frozen and evidenced before admission
downstream_after_F_KT10.coupling_release: none until temporal acceptance dependency itself is qualified; then resume the existing F-GC02 rather than creating a replacement
